Find plugins (bronto-\* executables on PATH)

```sh
bronto plugins <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto plugins list`](/reference/commands/plugins/#bronto-plugins-list) | List bronto-\* executables found on PATH |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto plugins list

List bronto-\* executables found on PATH

```sh
bronto plugins list [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

#### Examples

```sh
bronto plugins list
bronto plugins list -o json
```
